title: Harden edit_file (str_replace) with Resilient Whitespace-Relaxed Line Matching and Honest Multi-Line Diff Diagnostics
commitMessage: refactor(agent): address reviewer caveats with pattern matching and non-overlapping replace_all step
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Hardened edit_file / str_replace tool in agent.rs: (1) Added 5th-tier resilient whitespace-relaxed line matching fallback (replace_whitespace_relaxed) with proportional indentation adaptation and non-overlapping greedy advancement (idx += m) when replace_all is true; (2) Replaced broken single-line 100% false similarity diagnostics with sliding window multi-line block similarity and zero-fake-100% clamping; (3) Added token-level LCS diff diagnostics (diff_line_tokens) with idiomatic tuple pattern matching to clearly explain exact token discrepancies; (4) Output structured candidate block with >> indicators and pre-computed read_file recommendations; (5) Verified across 112 unit tests and clippy with 0 warnings.

caveatsAddressed.caveat: Replaced guarded unwraps with idiomatic pattern matching tuple extraction in diff_line_tokens
caveatsAddressed.resolution: Converted raw_diffs iteration to use pattern matching tuple extraction `if let ((Some(exp), None), (None, Some(act))) = (raw_diffs[k], raw_diffs[k + 1])`.

caveatsAddressed.caveat: Implemented greedy step non-overlapping matching advancement (idx += m) in replace_whitespace_relaxed when replace_all is true
caveatsAddressed.resolution: Updated replace_whitespace_relaxed match loop to increment by matched block size `m` when replace_all is true (`idx += m; continue;`).

rootCauses.cause: Brittle Exact-String Matching and Whitespace Sensitivity in edit_file
rootCauses.detail: LLMs frequently emit edits with standard 2-space or 4-space indentation or omit invisible trailing whitespaces present in source files, triggering immediate NOT_FOUND errors.
rootCauses.resolution: Implemented 5th-tier whitespace-relaxed line matching in replace_whitespace_relaxed that trims leading/trailing whitespace, automatically adapts indentation, and preserves CRLF/LF line ending conventions.

rootCauses.detail: Diagnostics calculated similarity solely against the first line of old_string. When the first line matched a common header, it reported 'similarity: 100%' despite lines 2+ diverging completely.
rootCauses.resolution: Implemented sliding window multi-line block similarity, zero-fake-100% clamping if lines differ, token-level LCS diffing (diff_line_tokens), and candidate context output with pre-calculated read_file recommendations.
